fact: NIDP says over 5M existing TINs are harmonised with Fayda and Fayda is mandatory for new TINs, per the Ministry of Revenue.
National ID Ethiopia's deck says over 5M existing TINs are harmonised with Fayda and Fayda is mandatory for new TINs nationally.
ICTD says Ethiopia's Ministry of Revenue was already using biometric data for taxpayer identification number registration, and the government uses those TINs for several public services.
ICTD says that since December 2023 each new taxpayer identification number created is connected to a Fayda national ID number, with mapping of existing TINs still a goal.
The deck lists a FIN-based TIN, a taxpayer number based on the Fayda ID number, as a Fayda use case.
